name: clockwork_golem
description: a Clockwork Golem, a bulky Luchuirp automaton of polished gold-brass plates: a domed brass head with a small knob on top and two round blue glass lens-eyes, big round blue pauldrons and blue thigh plates each bearing a gold gear emblem, a round chest window showing gears, grey coiled-spring joints at the shoulders, elbows and shins, huge round brass feet, a big brass wind-up key sticking out of its back at the upper-right, and a spiked brass mace-ball for a fist on EACH arm; it strikes with the spiked mace-ball fist of its RIGHT arm
hands: the striking spiked mace-ball fist is on its right arm on the screen-left side; its left arm on the screen-right side ends in an identical spiked mace-ball fist; both mace-balls are its fists and never come off the arms

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the right arm is lifted up over the domed head with its spiked mace-ball fist up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the right arm cocked behind the head with its spiked mace-ball fist hanging down behind the shoulders, the left mace-ball fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-left, the torso whips forward, the right arm sweeps over the head and is level, its spiked mace-ball fist pointing to the lower-left
strike.4: contact: right arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the spiked mace-ball fist smashing down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the left mace-ball arm swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the right arm carries on down until its spiked mace-ball fist nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, the wind-up key on its back tilting
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the right arm lifts its spiked mace-ball fist back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; the domed head snaps back toward the upper-right, the blue lens-eyes flicker, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (left mace-ball fist swung out to the right, right mace-ball arm thrown out to the left)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the right mace-ball fist dipping, the left mace-ball arm still out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the right mace-ball arm flung up, the left mace-ball arm drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the domed head droops, the right mace-ball fist lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the right arm's spiked mace-ball fist resting on the ground, the left mace-ball arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the right arm flung up limply with its spiked mace-ball fist still attached, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on its back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right; both arms sprawled on the ground with their spiked mace-ball fists still attached; the wind-up key jutting out beside its shoulders
death.6: bounce: the domed head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the mace-ball fists rock
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on its back, the blue lens-eyes dark, both spiked mace-ball fists on the ground beside it, still on its arms
